description: A reel to reel tape transport for the samplers. It works out a speed voltage so a sample starts, stops, changes direction and drifts the way tape does

params.text: A tap starts the machine, and the next one stops it
Sets the wow, an off centre rotation of the reels that makes the speed waver; this knob and the wow input are added together
Sets the inertia of the reels, so the speed takes time to settle after a change; this knob and the inertia input are added together
Runs the tape forward at normal speed
Runs the tape forward at half speed
Runs the tape forward at double speed, or four times speed if the menu is set that way
Runs the tape backward at normal speed
Runs the tape backward at half speed
Runs the tape backward at double speed, or four times speed if the menu is set that way

inputs.text: A pulse starts the machine, and the next one stops it
A high gate runs the machine and a low one stops it
A voltage added to the wow set by the knob
A voltage added to the inertia set by the knob
A pulse runs the tape forward at normal speed
A pulse runs the tape forward at half speed
A pulse runs the tape forward at double speed
A pulse runs the tape backward at normal speed
A pulse runs the tape backward at half speed
A pulse runs the tape backward at double speed
A voltage picks one of the six speeds, read as a note in any octave: C is double speed backward, C sharp backward, D half speed backward, D sharp half forward, E forward, F double forward
A pulse picks the previous of the six speeds
A pulse picks the next of the six speeds
A pulse picks one of the six speeds at random
A voltage added to what AUX OUT carries
A pulse switches the direction of travel straight over, without the reels slowing through a stop

outputs.text: The speed voltage the machine works out, to be patched to a sampler's speed input
A gate that is high while the machine is running, for keeping a second machine in step with this one
The click of the transport buttons, as a tape machine's would sound

notes: a sampler driven from AUX OUT needs its own speed knob at zero and its speed CV attenuator at maximum
it makes no sound of its own; it drives a sampler's playback speed
it attaches as an expander to Simpliciter, Simpliciter Multi and confusingSimpler, and reaches any other NYSTHI sampler through AUX OUT
menu: Fast Fwd and Fast Bwd Superfast — runs the double speed buttons at four times speed
TAPE SPEED — sets the speed the machine treats as normal: 9.5 cm/s, 19.0 cm/s or 38.0 cm/s
Send Tape Machine Sounds to the EXPANDER — passes the transport click sound on to the attached module
